items.quote: The strength of your questions doesn't lie only in uncovering details to qualify the buyer, his budget, location etc.
items.statement: The strength of your questions lies in uncovering details to qualify the buyer.

items.quote: We ask questions to uncover the current problem/needs and make the client tell HIMSELF first of all why solving this problem is important for him now.
items.statement: Ask questions to uncover a client's current problems and needs for better engagement.

items.quote: This is the concept I was clarifying again in today's training for real estate agents in Ray White Dubai.
items.statement: The author clarifies the concept of asking questions in sales during trainings for agents.

items.quote: 'And help me understand why you decided to invest in Dubai rather than investing in your home country?'
items.statement: A good question leads the client to articulate their reasons for choosing an investment.

items.quote: he believes what he is telling himself way more than any salesperson.
items.statement: Clients believe their own words more than what salespeople say, influencing their decision-making.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing the importance of asking questions in sales.
